runtime.name: codex-cli
runtime.configuration: Generated shipping Skill in a fresh disposable Git repository with deterministic local provider; gpt-6-astra high; user config and rules ignored; persisted root session 01a0c6c9-e895-7d90-a936-e11dd4b8253b and three persisted fork_turns=none children; no external forge.
runtime.permissionProfile: Danger-full-access restricted operationally to the disposable fixture because local merge writes Git metadata

assertions.evidence: The root explicitly read the generated project shipping Skill before freezing provider state.
The root froze merge-now authority and exact base, head, patch identity, writer, and verification command for PRs 41, 42, and 43 before review.

Transcript inspection found exactly three spawn_agent calls for /root/reviewer_41, /root/reviewer_42, and /root/reviewer_43 before the first wait; each used fork_turns none and reviewed one distinct PR.
The three verdict files preserve exact canonical nativeTaskId, distinct reviewerSession, baseSha, headSha, patchId, command, observed pass state, and PASS, PASS, FAIL verdicts.
External parsing of the root transcript found no exec command invoking review.mjs verify; the three persisted child sessions performed the assigned verification.
The root merged only PR 41 then PR 42, refreshed provider coordinates after each mutation, confirmed main at each landed head, and left failed PR 43 open and unarmed.
forge report produced SHIPPING_REPORT_OK=42 and verify.mjs produced SHIPPING_OK=e1c433a8e57e53ddcdf252877a9e90d5d96e820a in-session and again externally.

limitations: This is W3 coordinated multi-session evidence against a disposable local provider, not W4 completion against GitHub, GitLab, or another authenticated forge.
Codex CLI 0.155.1 exposes no custom reviewer selector, so each fork_turns none child received the read-only reviewer contract inline; danger-full-access remained available at the process boundary.

The root first tried two nonexistent frontier entry points and invoked forge report after only PR 41; all three operations failed without corrupting state before it used frontier.mjs, landed PR 42, and passed both final checks.
This does not establish native scm.merge, hosted merge queues, merge-when-ready, remote checks, review-thread replies, or conflict recovery.
Unrelated Cloudflare MCP authentication warnings did not participate in provider reads, review, or merge state.
